summary: Beltrami County, MN ladder tower dated 1931 (81 ft); surveyed in 1960 and marked removed; the Forest Fire Lookout Association index lists the site as gone.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Survey table lists the height as 81 ft; the 1960 survey note gives 85 ft overall. The table figure (81 ft, 24.7 m) is used in the record and both are stated in the story.

notes_for_editor: Single county survey plus a statewide list and the FFLA index. Removal date not given in any source. No description of what remains at the site today. The 81 ft table height and 85 ft overall height in the 1960 note differ. Brief's record (Beltrami County, 47.6501 -94.87746, gone) matches the survey coordinates.
